description: This is a Java test class for search persistence related to querying 'things' with various criteria, using JUnit. It defines test cases to verify search functionalities for attributes of different types (string, number, boolean) and their negations. It uses constants and factory classes to create criteria, and tests that the correct 'ThingId's are returned for each query.

classes.name: SimpleCriteriaIT
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for testing search criteria on 'things' in persistence layer.
